properties.description: Utility reports ~400 customers without power near Pea Ridge after a substation fault. Estimated restoration 6 hours. Residents on powered medical devices are at risk.
properties.headline: Synthetic power-outage event for Porchlight drill (not from NWS)
properties.instruction: Check on residents with powered medical devices. Offer cooling-center transport. Do not call 911 unless a life is at risk.
